people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Hazael
people.line: King of Aram (Syria), anointed by Elijah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: At that time Hazael king of Aram marched up and fought against Gath and captured it. Then he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
